labels.title: Report `counts` are frozen literals, not observations; the new mandatory failure report makes them actively false
"all 23 source importers stay byte-identical" contradicts the one owned file, which is one of the 23
The metadata capture to be "cached before launch" currently lives at module scope, so M7's `nullReason`/partial-report path is unreachable as written
The proposed `8MiB maxBuffer` is a widening, not a bound
"capture failure aborts before launch" collides with the external-consumer retarget run
Attribute store-lock release to process **exit**; the stdio `close` event is evidence completeness, not the reopen precondition
The CLOSED outer 150/TERM145/KILL149 proposal states no runner-startup budget, and the post-test detached drain is unaccounted for (assessment only)
"cap dispatch at 32" must be a distinctly labeled invariant, not an expected-count assertion
Per-row wire retention has no report-side bound, and the failure report enlarges what is serialized
Name the two fixed pre-ready launcher error shapes as failure-stage labels (without upgrading UNKNOWN)
"retained" should distinguish directory from store file, because product code unlinks a failed create
Two text-precision nits in the frozen plan

disposition: UNRESOLVED; this audit preserves the raw wording and numbering. Root must disposition every labeled item F1–F11 including F4a/F4b; no finding acceptance inferred.
